public_note: This package was found during the local Noether sweep as the missing standalone GDZ source package for Noether Paper 03. It resolves a source-staging gap for the web/source-audit workflow by supplying the GDZ article-level PDF, IIIF manifest, source map, and raw full-resolution page images. It is source/provenance support only, not a corrected TeX branch, translated reader, source-closure certification, or critical edition.

Package contents include the GDZ article-level PDF, GDZ IIIF manifest for PPN37721857X_0019, source map for pp.101-104 / canvases 00000109-00000112, four raw full-resolution IIIF JPG page witnesses at 3352x5277 px, checksums, and a web-session source-gap note.
